matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 61/100 (above average) against BUF's run defense at 6/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: The Patriots head to Buffalo as 7-point underdogs in what looks like a classic David-versus-Goliath matchup on paper — except we've got the slingshot and they've got a glaring weakness we can actually exploit. New England's rush offense (61/100) faces Buffalo's run defense (6/100), the widest statistical edge anywhere on the field this week, which feels like less of a coincidence and more like an instruction manual. The problem, of course, is that our pass offense is struggling at 23/100 while their pass defense is elite at 32/100, and with Greg Van Roten now on injured reserve, Drake Maye's already-fragile pocket (our pass protection grades at a horrifying 10/100) just got worse against Buffalo's 71/100 pass rush. We're 1-2 coming off three games where we've been slightly negative in EPA per play; Buffalo is 3-0 and slightly positive over their last three. This one feels like it all comes down to whether we can lean on the ground game, protect Maye enough to let it work, and whether our elite pass defense (87/100) can rattle Josh Allen before he picks us apart.
